description: SET pointer UP/DOWN BY (data-pointer arithmetic), ISO §2023:14.9.39 Format 10 - introduced 2002 (GR20 byte-granular movement; GR18 NULL -> EC-DATA-PTR-NULL; GR19: an amount that does not evaluate to an integer is a runtime EC-SIZE-ADDRESS fatal, and GR20's own arm - a resulting address outside the implementor data-pointer range (DOC-A.1-216) - is EC-RANGE-PTR with the operand unchanged, two rules with two conditions via CobolPtr.UpByAmount). LIVE (Phase-4b increment 2, DEVLOG 617): the D-U7 category re-route on the shared 85 index grammar shape - the 85 index form itself stays ungated.
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.39 Format 10 (§2023:14.9.39.4 GR18, GR19, GR20); 2002 introduction (derive from the 2002 standard — Annex E covers 2014→2023 only)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. PAMX1.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 X PIC X(5) VALUE "HELLO".
01 P USAGE POINTER.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    SET P TO ADDRESS OF X.
    SET P UP BY 2.
    STOP RUN.
